status: measured same-host release warm single-forward baseline
method: Four predictions with one resident session/model; report first separately and median of the remaining three. F32 stored weights and F32 arithmetic, identical BF16-rounded 33x35 input, 18 caption tokens, batch 1, eight CPU threads. PyTorch checkpoint hooks and disk writes disabled inside timed forwards.
limitations: Container has a 16-CPU quota and 55 GiB memory limit despite reporting 128 logical CPUs and about 500 GiB host memory.
Other workloads share this host; a repository-local CPU quantization worker was active. These samples are a reference, not an isolated-machine guarantee.
Rust Vulkan is hybrid: CPU normalization/RoPE/elementwise operations and synchronous projection upload/readback; the caption encoder is excluded from this DiT-only benchmark.
Default-resolution generation timings are reported separately from this small-forward fixture.
